en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibrahim Al Hamdany, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of the Exalted
[21:47] And We will Set up an Equitable Scale on the Day of Judgement
. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Prophets<sup>as</sup> and the successors<sup>asws</sup>’.
